summary: Anghami Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a senior unsecured loan agreement with UBC Ventures W.L.L., an affiliate of OSN Streaming Limited, for up to US$20 million. The loan matures on April 29, 2028, bears interest at 8% plus six-month Term SOFR, and is for general corporate purposes and working capital. The board approved the agreement upon unanimous recommendation of a special committee. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return. No extraordinary corporate action is triggered.
